name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.254: The auto-sync no longer guesses a cue's kind from its capitalisation. A cue that is
    nothing but bracket groups — "(gunshot)", "(crowd shouting)", "[door slams]" — is a sound label
    and stays out of the fit, however it is written; embedded SDH tracks write these in lower case,
    where the capitals rule saw nothing (336 of 22 992 cues measured over 30 embedded HI tracks). The
    opposite direction matters more: a cue that STARTS with a bracket group but carries dialogue
    outside it ("(SCOFFS) Okay, so now what?", "[Shirley] Hey!") is dialogue and now feeds the fit
    again — the old rule dropped 1 848 such cues. Net effect on the same corpus: sound labels fall
    from 22.9 % to 16.3 % of the cues, and the fit gains 1 848 real dialogue anchors.
